title: Show-Harness: Just a VLM Agent Can Play Robots
authors: Yanzhe Chen, Zechen Bai, Zhijun Cao, Wenzheng Zeng, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Yiqi Lin, Guoqiang Liang, Kevin Yuchen Ma, Qiming Huang, Mike Zheng Shou

tldr.zh: Show-Harness 让 VLM 根据图像、状态和执行历史选择离散语义微动作，再由机器人专用解释器转换为位姿增量与夹爪控制，以同一接口支持前沿模型零样本操作、小模型微调和 GUI 示范采集。
tldr.en: Show-Harness lets a VLM select discrete semantic micro-actions from images, state and interaction history; embodiment-specific interpreters convert them into pose increments and gripper commands, sharing one interface for frontier zero-shot control, small-model fine-tuning and GUI demonstration collection.

evaluation_scope.zh: 基本接口为六方向移动、抓取、释放与完成，按需增加旋转，双臂增加闲置符号；解释器提供步长、视角到机器人坐标变换及运动限制。Franka 以阻抗控制跟踪末端位姿，AgileX 用 IK 与关节目标执行。零样本模式默认 Gemini-3.1 Pro，规划与控制角色配合子任务判定、动作历史、步长／动作块调整及失败重试；微调模式默认 Qwen3.5-2B，以动作符号交叉熵训练 rank-64 LoRA，冻结视觉编码器和多模态投影，默认无独立规划器，无 RL 或专用动作头。部署反馈更新上下文和动作，不在线更新模型权重。真机 Franka Research 3 七自由度臂与 AgileX 六自由度单／双臂均配平行夹爪，未验证多指灵巧手。标准评测五物体×盘／碗共十任务，默认每项十次、最多五十步。FT 使用 164 条真机示范共同训练两种机械臂，不能称为未见机械臂零样本迁移；仿真到真机另用 230 条仿真示范。GUMI 以相同按钮／键盘动作采集观测—动作对及低层轨迹。官方已公开代码、真机／仿真数据和六个 LoRA 适配器（五个真机、一个仿真，需对应基座）。
evaluation_scope.en: The basic interface has six translations, grasp, release and done, with optional rotations and dual-arm idle. Interpreters supply metric increments, view-to-robot transforms and motion limits; Franka uses impedance control, AgileX IK/joint targets. Zero-shot Gemini-3.1 Pro combines planning/controller roles with subtask checks, history, adaptive steps/chunks and retries. Fine-tuned Qwen3.5-2B predicts action symbols with cross-entropy and rank-64 LoRA, freezing vision/projector, without RL, a dedicated action head or a separate default planner. Deployment feedback changes context/actions, not weights. Real Franka Research 3 (7-DoF) and AgileX (6-DoF, single/dual arm) use parallel grippers; multi-finger hands are untested. Ten standard tasks pair five objects with plate/bowl, normally ten trials each and fifty-step limits. FT jointly trains on both arm platforms using 164 real demonstrations, not unseen-arm zero-shot transfer; separate sim-to-real training uses 230 simulated demonstrations. GUMI records observation/action pairs and low-level traces through the same keyboard/button units. Official releases include code, real/sim data and six LoRA adapters: five real-corpus models and one sim model, requiring their base models.
